Local integration note
======================

triangle-wasm.js is a Browserify standalone bundle of the published wrapper.
Local wrapper changes include forwarding WebAssembly initialization
rejections to the caller so a failed load cannot leave the application
waiting forever.
Local adaptation: the JavaScript wrapper's numberofcorners setter accepts
TRI3 refinement input (3) for Triangle's existing -r refinement mode.
Local memory adaptation: relax the binary's imported-memory maximum (formerly
256 pages / 16 MiB) without changing Triangle machine code. The JavaScript
runtime grows memory on demand, refreshes IO views and frees shared fields
before their IO structure. Reproduce with scripts/patch-triangle-memory.cjs.
